## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Skill behavior
- [ ] Template/reference content
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling or maintenance

## Validation

Explain how the change was reviewed or tested.

## Portability checklist

- [ ] No provider-specific dependency was added to a core skill.
- [ ] No client-, organization-, or project-specific assumptions were added.
- [ ] Facts, assumptions, unknowns, recommendations, and decisions remain distinct.
- [ ] Human approval boundaries remain explicit where authoritative content can change.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or contracts changed.
